text:
maria: heads up - running onboarding smoke for quant-int8 variant (v2-quant) and seeing token misalignment when a long system prepend is used + stream_resume=true. reproducible locally and on dedicated.
kevin: hmm, can you paste the minimal repro?
maria: gist of repro: we do a 8k system prompt + 2 context messages, then stream an extra 4k prompt in chunks. first response ok, but after KV eviction happens output tokens shift.
jasper: "shift" as in repeated prefixes or hallucinated token ids? example?
maria: pasted logs below (trimmed). note the difference between fp16 and int8 runs.
maria: ```bash
# run repro
python tests/longctx/repro_stream_resume.py --model v2-quant --stream_resume true --sys_len 8000 --stream_chunks 4
```
maria: log snippet (int8):
```
[0.12s] init kv_len=8192
[12.3s] served tokens 12000, kv_evicted=1
[12.30s] output: "The protocol requires that"
[12.31s] output(next): " requirements are satisfied by"  <-- expected continuation: " that the client"
```
jasper: int8 only? what about fp16?
maria: fp16 run keeps continuity. int8 shows token misalignment right after kv_evicted counter increments.
sophia: could be quantized attention kernel not handling circular buffer wrap when offsets shift. any RoPE scaling differences?
maria: we toggled rotary_scale=auto vs none. with `rotary_scale=auto` the drift is smaller but still present. disabling RoPE (for test) removes the shift entirely.
kevin: sounds like an index mapping bug when we rebase KV cache after eviction + quantized relpos math. can you dump the kv indices around eviction?
maria: added quick dump: `kv_meta.dump()` shows last_index=65536, base=57344 before eviction, after eviction base bumped to 61440 but some tokens still read with old base.
jasper: that smells like stale prefix entries in `cached_prefix_map` not getting updated for quantized layouts. do you have a tiny repro we can run in CI?
ci-bot: triggered test: longctx/kv-resume-int8-1840523456 on darwin-latest (shard 7).
ci-bot: test failed: token-diff at step 1024 (exit 1). logs: `tests/longctx/logs/1840523456-int8.log`
kevin: i'll add an instrumented build with asserts around `rebase_kvcache()` to check index invariants.
maria: thanks. also noticed that when we `prepend` a stream chunk (client-side) rather than send as a new request, the server sometimes treats it as a prefix and doesn't update prefix_version causing mismatch. i can repro with `prepend=true` in our harness.
sophia: important to test both `prepend=true` and explicit new request. good catch. might explain why hosted customers with streaming UIs hit this more.
jasper: propose a triage plan: (1) reproduce in isolated unit test that simulates eviction + quantized kernel path, (2) add invariant checks + fuzz with varying `sys_len` and chunk sizes, (3) compare outputs fp16 vs int8 to ensure parity, (4) run canary on dedicated with canary routing.
kevin: adding to that: instrument RoPE phase calculation before/after rebase to log any discontinuities. if we see a jump in `rotary_phase_offset` at eviction that's the smoking gun.
maria: i already have a quick hook - here's sample debug print: `rotary_phase_offset[layer][pos]` snapshot before/after eviction shows abrupt discontinuity at pos ~61440 for int8 only.
jasper: ok, i'll start a small PR that adds the invariant + a failing unit test. can you attach the failing log to the issue?
maria: attaching: tests/longctx/fixtures/1840523456/{input.txt,fp16.out,int8.out,kv_meta.before,kv_meta.after} (uploaded).
kevin: FYI infra: we should avoid rolling this quantized kernel to stable until fix. can we quarantine model `v2-quant` in dedicated image tag `quarantine/1840523456`?
infra-bot: ack - created tag `quarantine/1840523456` and paused auto-deploy for `v2-quant`.
ci-bot: rerun queued: longctx/kv-resume-int8-1840523456 (shard 3).
sophia: also check prompt caching path - prefix caching could bypass some rebase logic. i remember a previous fix around `prefix_version` that might have regressed when we parallelized quant kernels.
jasper: good call. i'll grep for `prefix_version` usage in `quant_kernels/*` and run static check.
maria: timeline: i can write the unit test today, kevin can add asserts, jasper will send PR. then we run canary next week.
kevin: thanks, team. any chance this affects embeddings or only generation?
maria: only generation so far (attention path). embeddings path doesn't use streaming/resume.
jasper: adding a note to model-onboarding checklist: run `longctx/kv-eviction` fuzz for int8 variants with prepend=true.
kevin: :thumbsup:
sophia: leaving a quick tip in docs: "When using stream_resume with long system prepends, prefer fp16 until quant kernels on rebase are validated."
maria: will update the onboarding checklist and open the issue: https://redwood.atlassian.com/browse/INF-1840523456 (created).
kevin: one more ask - can we gather a small diff of logits around the step where misalignment starts? that'll help root cause.
maria: yes, pushing `tests/longctx/diffs/1840523456/logit-diff-step-1024.json` now.
ci-bot: note - flaky threshold: 3/10 runs fail for int8 on darwin. marking flaky in test metadata.
kevin: perfect. i'll pick this up after stand. thanks all. :rocket:
